summary: Preinstall native addon exfiltrates CI/cloud credentials to oob.s4yhii.com
details: @brick-v2/table@999.0.3 presents itself as a table/UI module exposing forRoot/createLogger stubs, but ships a native addon at prebuilds/<platform>-<arch>/metrics.node that performs credential harvesting on install. package.json declares preinstall='node index.js || true'; index.js require()s the platform-specific.node binary inside a try/catch so any error is silently suppressed. On load, the native addon's napi_register_module_v1 reads AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, GITHUB_TOKEN, NPM_TOKEN, AZURE_DEVOPS_EXT_PAT, ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN and other credential-grade environment variables along with hostname, username and cwd, and POSTs them as a JSON envelope ('{"src":"native","pkg":"%s",...}') to http://oob.s4yhii.com/native. The scope/name shape and 999.0.3 version are consistent with a dependency-confusion lure targeting an internal @brick-v2 package. The UI-stub façade and 'metrics' naming are cover-story framing for the native stealer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
